payload.body: You tend to ask the direct question and use the plain word when everyone else is circling the subject. You can discuss sex, anger, money, shame, or disagreement without needing to make the conversation dramatic. You usually understand that silence does not make a difficult fact less real. People trust your honesty because you can be direct without using cruelty to prove that you are truthful.
